subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Teams channel/group Graph media fallback run by default for non-personal HTML stubs, or be gated behind an explicit channels.msteams option?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the safe fix shape affects existing operator Graph call volume and the prior mention-only false-positive protection.

options.title: Choose config-gated fallback
options.body: Land a default-off option like the newer PR so existing mention-only behavior stays unchanged and operators opt into extra Graph lookups for file recovery.

options.title: Choose default fallback
options.body: Land the broader channel fallback if maintainers accept extra Graph lookups as the default behavior needed to make documented channel attachment support work.

options.title: Reconcile both PRs first
options.body: Ask the PR authors to converge the channel URL fixes and group-chat gate into one branch before merge review continues.

recommendation.title: Choose config-gated fallback
recommendation.body: Land a default-off option like the newer PR so existing mention-only behavior stays unchanged and operators opt into extra Graph lookups for file recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest visible history on plugin boundaries, config compatibility, and Teams hardening, which are the core product tradeoffs here.
